metadata.title: Vintage Sepia Group Portrait with Distressed Texture

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, wide-shot group portrait of six men in formal suits standing on a gravel path, framed by tall manicured hedges and palm trees. The entire image is treated with a warm sepia-tone wash and heavy, horizontal distressed textures resembling worn paper or aged film stock.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure dominates the composition through scale and central placement.
The gravel path creates a receding perspective line leading to the subjects.
High-contrast shadows in the suits against the bright, blown-out sky.
Horizontal distressing marks create a physical barrier between the viewer and the subjects.
coreInvariants: Heavy horizontal grain and scratch overlays

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six men arranged in a loose horizontal line across the center; the central figure is slightly larger and more forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the dark suit and sunglasses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central figure, move outward to the flanking men, then down to the large script typography at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of bright, textured sky in the upper half of the frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between dark clothing and light environment.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a highly ornate, flowing script with long swashes.
Secondary text uses a bold, extended, all-caps serif.
Both styles feature a 3D bevel and drop shadow effect.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended tails on the 'P', 'D', and 'y' to frame the secondary text.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate calligraphic script paired with a stable, wide architectural serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider line below the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ornate, flourished calligraphic style of the primary text.
Matches the wide, small-serif aesthetic of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photo of a group of men in dark suits standing on a gravel path in a garden with tall hedges. Apply a monochromatic sepia filter and overlay heavy horizontal white and dark scratches to simulate aged paper.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, ornate gold script title at the bottom center. Beneath it, add a wide, all-caps bronze serif subtitle with a chiseled 3D effect and a thin horizontal line underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia?
Is the texture heavy and horizontal?
Does the script text have long, elegant flourishes?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the group
Amount of flourish in the script
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the horizontal scratches do not obscure the faces too much.
Check that the 3D effect on the text feels integrated with the lighting.
Verify the sepia tone is consistent across the entire image.
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a group portrait in formal wear + apply sepia monochrome + overlay horizontal grit/scratches + add beveled script and wide serif typography at the base.
